title: Answer the water crisis

approval.notes: Three forge responses before the watch checkpoint night consequence.

concrete_order: Forge a response to the tainted water before the watch tightens the ward.
hidden_contradiction: Every honest fix protects Aita while every hidden flaw trades her safety for leverage over Henning or Jürgen.

investigation_clues.summary: The public well carries runoff instead of clean draw water.
Aita's ale is sound, but she draws from the same tainted municipal line.
Merchant barrels match spoiled grain quietly routed through the ward.
Henning's cistern is cracked and choked with runoff at the checkpoint.

forging_options.label: Forge reinforced brewery bands to secure Aita's vats.
Forge a tampered inspection seal to redirect the watch.
Forge a detention-cart lock with a hidden release flaw.

night_consequence: The forged response changes watch checkpoint routes and brewery pressure during investigation night.

source_notes.summary: P2-008 forge commission with three audiovisual outcomes before P2-009 night encounter.
